```yaml
name: Release Precompiled Binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}
      release_tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Get version from tag
        id: get_version
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="${{ github.ref_name }}"
          echo "version=$TAG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
      - name: Validate version matches Cargo.toml
        run: |
          TAG_VERSION="${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
          CARGO_VERSION=$(grep -E "^version\s*=" Cargo.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)
          if [[ "$TAG_VERSION" != "v$CARGO_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Version mismatch: tag=$TAG_VERSION, Cargo.toml=$CARGO_VERSION"
            exit 1
          fi
          
      - name: Create Draft Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false

  build-cli:
    needs: create-release
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          # Linux x86_64
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            cuda: ""
            name: cake-linux-x86_64
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            cuda: "11.8"
            name: cake-linux-x86_64-cuda118
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            cuda: "12.4"
            name: cake-linux-x86_64-cuda124
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            cuda: "13.0"
            name: cake-linux-x86_64-cuda130
          # Linux aarch64
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            cuda: ""
            name: cake-linux-aarch64
          # macOS arm64
          - target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
            cuda: ""
            name: cake-macos-arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Install lld
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          override: true
          
      - name: Setup CUDA Toolkit
        if: matrix.cuda != ''
        uses: actions/setup-nvidia-driver@v1
        with:
          cuda-version: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
          
      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu'
        run: |
          cargo install cross --version 0.2.5
          
      - name: Build CLI
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" ]]; then
            RUSTC_WRAPPER="" cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --bin cake
          else
            RUSTC_WRAPPER="" cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --bin cake
          fi
          
      - name: Package CLI
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-apple-darwin" ]]; then
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake dist/cake
          else
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake dist/cake
          fi
          tar -czvf dist/${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz -C dist cake
          sha256sum dist/${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz > dist/${{ matrix.name }}.sha256
          
      - name: Upload CLI Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}
          path: dist/${{ matrix.name }}.*

  build-mobile:
    needs: create-release
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          # Android aarch64
          - target: aarch64-linux-android
            os: ubuntu-latest
            name: cake-mobile-android-aarch64
          # iOS arm64
          - target: aarch64-apple-ios
            os: macos-latest
            name: cake-mobile-ios-arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          override: true
          
      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-linux-android'
        run: |
          cargo install cross --version 0.2.5
          
      - name: Build Mobile Library
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-linux-android" ]]; then
            RUSTC_WRAPPER="" cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --lib --manifest-path mobile/Cargo.toml
          else
            RUSTC_WRAPPER="" cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --lib --manifest-path mobile/Cargo.toml
          fi
          
      - name: Package Mobile Library
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-linux-android" ]]; then
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/libcake_mobile.so dist/libcake_mobile.so
          elif [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-apple-ios" ]]; then
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/libcake_mobile.a dist/libcake_mobile.a
          fi
          tar -czvf dist/${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz -C dist libcake_mobile.*
          sha256sum dist/${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz > dist/${{ matrix.name }}.sha256
          
      - name: Upload Mobile Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}
          path: dist/${{ matrix.name }}.*

  publish-release:
    needs: [create-release, build-cli, build-mobile]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          
      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: artifacts/**/*
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.release_tag }}
          overwrite: true
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
```
